summary: Prerequisites for the first network playbook tutorial: Ansible 2.10+, compatible network devices, basic Linux CLI and basic switch/router config knowledge.
questions: What do I need before starting network automation with Ansible?
What Ansible version do I need for network collections?

answer_card.title: Network tutorial prerequisites
answer_card.answer_md:
- Ansible 2.10 or higher
- One or more Ansible-compatible network devices
- Basic Linux command line knowledge
- Basic switch and router configuration knowledge
